subject: CSA control mapping & evidence choreography — Meridian Bancorp
messages:
From: Sara Holt <sara.holt@meridianbank.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Cc: controls@meridianbank.com
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CSA mapping request — initial scope and artifacts

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for taking this on. Meridian is kicking off a CSA (CAIQ) review for a set of services we plan to include in an upcoming procurement window. We need: 

- A control-level mapping (CSA/CAIQ spreadsheet) aligning Redwood controls to CSA identifiers (we prefer a single worksheet per control family).
- Representative evidence for key controls: sample runtime logs, keystore rotation proof, and retention policy snippets.
- A short control narrative for any controls where we rely on compensating controls.

Scope: public hosted API + dedicated capacity (we'll attach a scope list after confirmation). Can you confirm turnaround and what format you prefer for evidence exchange? Meridian requires evidence delivery into a controlled shared Drive link and an NDA/limited disclosure before we accept any PII-level artifacts.

High-level timeline request: mapping + sample artifacts by 10 Nov so our procurement team can review before the 18 Nov board packet. Is that feasible?

Appreciate it — happy to sync for a quick walkthrough if useful.

Thanks,
Sara Holt
Director, Controls & Vendor Risk
Meridian Bancorp

----
Attachment: meridian_scope_list.xlsx (xlsx)
From: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Holt <sara.holt@meridianbank.com>
Cc: jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 03 Nov 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CSA mapping request — initial scope and artifacts

Sara — thanks, we can definitely support this cadence. High level plan below and owner assignments: 

1) Scoping & template (today): we will use a single-sheet CSA mapping (CAIQ v4) — attached is our CAIQ_mapping_template.xlsx.
2) Control narratives & evidence pulls (3–8 Nov): Jordan will author control narratives for runtime/operational controls and pull redacted runtime log samples.
3) Evidence & policy artifacts (8–10 Nov): Kimberly will provide retention policy excerpts, keystore rotation summary, and any attestation PDFs.
4) Delivery & intake (10 Nov): we will upload a zipped evidence bundle to a controlled Drive folder and share a DocuSign-limited-disclosure link for acceptance.

Quick asks from your side to keep the timeline: please confirm the final scope (services + tenant residency) and whether you need raw logs or redacted/parity samples. For now we will plan to provide redacted runtime logs and a short ingestion readme.

We will not include customer data. If Meridian requires proof of isolation for Dedicated, call out which tenant IDs are in scope so Jordan can include tenancy metadata in the narrative.

Attaching: CAIQ_mapping_template.xlsx (template we prefer).

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Trust Programs
Redwood Inference

----
Attachment: CAIQ_mapping_template.xlsx (xlsx)
From: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 04 Nov 2027 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: ACTION: Meridian CSA — owner tasks & artifacts (internal)

Jordan/Kim — forwarding Meridian's ask. Please see assignments below: 

Jordan (owner for operational controls):
- Populate CAIQ mapping template for families CC, IA, LOG, and OPS. Add a short control narrative (2–4 sentences) per control and flag any with compensating controls.
- Produce a redacted runtime_logs_sample.log demonstrating a representative session (timestamps, anonymized request IDs, and cache hit/miss metrics). Mask any customer identifiers.
- Call out kernel/quantization caveats where relevant for inference telemetry (brief inline note).

Kimberly (owner for compliance artifacts & legal gating):
- Pull the keystore_rotation_summary.pdf and the retention_policy excerpt (to be attached). Confirm whether the keystore artifact can be shared under a limited disclosure or needs additional redaction.
- Prepare the DocuSign-limited-disclosure envelope and the Drive folder ACL (Meridian should be viewer-only with expiration).

Let's aim to have drafts uploaded to our secure Drive folder by COB 10 Nov. Jordan, if you hit a snag with producing a redacted log sample, send me a short note and I will coordinate an alternate artifact (e.g., replay snippet + sampling manifest).

Thanks — tagging for visibility.

—Lauren
Head of Trust Programs
Redwood Inference

----
Attachment: runtime_logs_sample.log (log); keystore_rotation_summary.pdf (pdf)
From: Sara Holt <sara.holt@meridianbank.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Cc: controls@meridianbank.com
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 08:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CSA mapping request — initial scope and artifacts

Lauren — this looks great, thanks for the clarity and owner assignments. Meridian confirms: 

- Scope: public hosted API (prod region: us-west-2) + dedicated capacity pool "meridian-prod-1". Tenant IDs will be provided in a sealed spreadsheet after the NDA is in place.
- Evidence preference: redacted samples + supporting manifest; retention excerpts and keystore rotation summary are sufficient for procurement.
- Delivery: please upload to the Drive link above and share the DocuSign-limited-disclosure (we will countersign).

If you can get the mapping + at least the retention excerpt and keystore summary into Drive by EOD 10 Nov, we will accept a follow-up packet with the redacted logs early next week. That meets our internal packet deadline for review.

I'll expect the DocuSign envelope and the Drive access link — happy to brief procurement if anything comes back unclear.

Regards,
Sara Holt
Director, Controls & Vendor Risk
Meridian Bancorp

----
Note: please send Drive ACL to controls@meridianbank.com when ready.
